text:
Type: circle patterned cushion
Use: on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with a subtle sheen
Colors: off-white ground, sand beige, pale aqua, light grey, tan
Shape: square cushion with rows of large two-tone circles threaded on thin vertical lines like beads, soft and full
Feel: light, calm, playful, airy
Goes with: beige or grey sofas, light wood, aqua or sand accents; mid-century, retro or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: OTTIL
product.description: Jacquard weave gives the cushion cover a pattern with a subtle, slightly raised relief.
